definition: Commercial routing layered on top of the existing leakage engine. Cohorts are deduplicated within each lane; a contact without a deal never receives a monetary estimate.

missing_deal_predeal_recovery.amount_rule: No amount assigned without an existing deal.

active_deal_leakage_and_escalation.amount_rule: Actual amount on existing open deals only; not a forecast.

closed_lost_recovery.amount_rule: Historical closed-lost amount is context only and is never added to open pipeline or presented as recoverable revenue.

score_rule: Recovery opportunity signals do not lower the integrity score unless a separate reviewer-approved integrity finding does so.
